newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - RTZ-CRA says will run copper at full speed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - RTZ-CRA says will run copper at full speed.

text.p: RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd said on Thursday the group would continue to run its copper operations at full speed.

"Our copper operations have costs which are well below even the most pessimistic forecasts of the direction of copper prices," chief executive Robert Wilson said from London during a televised briefing after the release of half year results.
"There would still still be a good contribution to cash flow and earnings from operations at 100 percent," Wilson said.

Wilson said the company would only consider a change if it believed there was a serious problem of over-supply emerging which would do long-term damage to the copper price. "Right now we don't particularly see those circumstances," he said.
RTZ-CRA said earlier that its refined copper production was reduced by 28 percent in the first half of 1996 due to production delays at its new Kennecott Co smelter in the United States.
